history_summary.value: The Ayam Ketawa, or laughing chicken, comes from Sidenreng Rappang in South Sulawesi, Indonesia, and was originally kept as a status symbol by Buginese royalty. It remains a symbol of courage and social status and is entered into crowing contests judged on the clarity and length of its call.
